subject: Rollback guardrails for tier swap and feature gating
messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tier swap — can we get rollback guardrails?

Hi Vivek,

Quick question as we look to move a subset of traffic to Dedicated-Lite next month: can Redwood support a controlled tier swap where we bump to the higher throughput tier but keep a couple of premium features (notably multitenant isolation and the long-term KV retention) disabled for the first 30 days?

Our concerns are twofold: 1) cost/exposure if we misjudge traffic, and 2) a clean rollback path if we see any latency regressions or quality drops. We heard you can offer some kind of credit/rollback arrangement — can you outline what that looks like and whether any discount is possible for the pilot?

If it helps, Eric (cc'd) will run the pilot against our non-prod traffic and we want an explicit rollback trigger (latency > 130ms p95; error > 2%).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Park
Head of ML Products, Brightline Health
Attachments: none

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Eric Zhao <eric@brightlinehealth.com>; Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tier swap — can we get rollback guardrails?

Sarah — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes. We have a few well‑tested patterns for this exact scenario; here's a practical playbook and proposed commercial treatment so you can review with Eric and your finance team.

1) Technical path (what we'll run):
- Canary: route 10% of inference volume to Dedicated-Lite (non-prod first, then prod) for 7 days.
- Feature gating: we will keep multitenant isolation and KV retention off for the pilot; feature flags enforced at request router.
- Telemetry/SLOs: Redwood will monitor p95 latency, token error rates, and throughput; we’ll push a protected dashboard link during the pilot.

2) Rollback & credits (commercial safeguard):
- If your defined triggers are breached (you suggested p95 > 130ms or error > 2%) during the pilot window, Redwood will:
  a) automatically route traffic back to the previous tier within 30 minutes, and
  b) apply a credit equal to 25% of Dedicated-Lite invoiced usage for the pilot period (applied against next invoice).
- We can tighten the credit to 30% if Brightline commits to a 6‑month post-pilot term.

3) Pricing & discounting: 
- Baseline upgrade pricing is standard Dedicated-Lite rate. For pilot economics, we can provide a one-time pilot discount (12% off the tier for the pilot window) plus the rollback credit above.
- Any extended discount requires approval from pricing committee (looping Kimberly for that).

4) Contract logistics:
- I’m attaching a short term sheet (redwood-rollback-term-sheet.pdf) and a draft amendment (amendment-draft-v1.docx) that documents the pilot window, rollback triggers, credits, and a simple DocuSign clause.

Next steps: if this looks reasonable I’ll route a 12% pilot discount + term sheet to Kimberly and Ben for quick approval and send you a DocuSign link. Also confirm the exact telemetry thresholds you want (you suggested p95 130ms).

Happy to hop on a 20‑minute call with Eric tomorrow if useful.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-rollback-term-sheet.pdf, amendment-draft-v1.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Tier swap — can we get rollback guardrails? (pricing approval)

Looping in Ben for finance sign-off. Vivek — I'm comfortable approving a pilot discount up to 12% + the 25% rollback credit you outlined, contingent on the following:
- Deal ID recorded (DL-49821) and HubSpot milestone set to "Pilot - Legal Review"
- Finance must sign the amendment; credits should be redeemable within 90 days and visible on the invoice as a separate line item
- We should cap the total refundable credit exposure to $25k for this pilot (we can revisit if Brightline commits longer term)

Ben — can you confirm we can set a $25k credit cap and add the DocuSign flow? If yes I’ll approve and Vivek can send to Brightline.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Pricing & Packaging, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Park <sarah@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Zhao <eric@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 15:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tier swap — can we get rollback guardrails?

Vivek/Kimberly — this works for us. Brightline agrees to the 12% pilot discount and accepts the 25% rollback credit with the $25k cap noted by Kimberly. We’ll run the pilot on non-prod first and then promote to a 10% prod canary if the non-prod pass is clean.

Please send the amendment and DocuSign link (Eric will be the signee). Confirm: rollback trigger = p95 latency > 130ms OR token error rate > 2% over a 10‑minute rolling window. Also please include a link to the live telemetry dashboard for the duration of the pilot.

Appreciate the quick turn — Eric and I will watch the first 48 hours closely.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Park
Head of ML Products, Brightline Health
